overview: A cross-mission lunar image registration and quantitative correspondence analysis platform for Chandrayaan-2, NASA LRO and JAXA SELENE imagery, with a React/TypeScript interface and a Go-first backend architecture supported by a Python/OpenCV computer-vision worker.
features: Register moving and reference lunar images across illumination, scale, viewpoint, resolution and sensor variations
Extract and match local features with descriptor filtering and geometric verification
Estimate Similarity, Affine and Homography transforms using RANSAC
Visualize correspondences, inliers, outliers, registered imagery, overlays and difference maps
Calculate RMSE, reprojection error, inlier ratio, spatial coverage, scale and rotation from actual correspondences
Compare model configurations and preserve reproducible experiment records
Export registration results, metrics, correspondence data and technical reports
